I bought the 2.5 size. And I would definitely recommendI LOVE this brand buuuutttt…there’s no screen. I read a review that spoke to this however, I had to see for myself and it’s true folks. This is a deal breaker for me and I’ll buy direct from the company in order to get it for a few more dollars. Happy grindn!Purchased for a friend who has giant man hands, for real! He had a smaller version and this one allows him to grind his flowerThis grinder was a gift but the recipient of this grinder/gift is very happy. He says it works great and loves the size of it. Great product.Grinder works great!I HAVE BOUGHT TWO OF THESE, ONE LARGER THAN THIS ONE AND BOTH WORK REALLY GREAT...GRINDS VERY WELL AND THE OUTSIDE OF THESE GRINDERS HAVE THE SHAPE TO HOLD ON TO THEM AS WELL WHEN YOU ARE BREAKING DOWN BUD. reviews_1s:
The grinder is great just don’t buy from this vendor or company, they are sending grinders that are missing the kief sifter so all your product falls to where the kief should be. I’ve had this grinder in the past and it’s the best one on the market, probably got it from another vendor about 5 years ago but after 5 years of consistent use at $20 i decided to get a new one just so it’s cleaner and smoother. Get one, just not from these peopleI got a few decades in this shindig. In my opinion, this is really close to a mechanically perfect grinder design.

Pros:
Large grips on the outside.
Good threads
No screen

Cons:
cutouts for screen on bottom catch debris even though there's no screen
The biggest: the aluminum is soft. If you hit to pieces together to empty it, you will get metal shavings in your output.

I bought this one because it was the closest thing I could find in shape, but that materials are no good. Everyone in the history of forever bangs the grinder parts together to empty them... and you can test the metal and see how soft the aluminum is. It will not stay sharp for too long. I'm back to looking for a stainless steel or titanium one after buying this. I really wanted to like it but it's made with such soft aluminum I can't.Bunch of pointless extras and no screen. Feels like half of the product is missing. Clearly cutting corners now, as they used to come with the inner screen under the muller. Does nothing to replace my previous Kozo of the exact same variety now since they wanted to give me a stupid mini zip bag, a sticker, and a guitar pick. Very very disappointing. Was missing from both color varieties. Won't be buying or recommending.not the color advertised. they need to update their picture for the rose gold grinder as the one that I received looks nothing like the picture, more of an orange color! I bought this before a couple years ago and it doesn’t have the kief catcher anymore either. disappointed that I spent $25 on this for it to not even be pinkKozo stopped adding the Kief collector that gave you a place to store the scraper and brush that comes with it. all the reviews on YouTube of Kozo girders have this feature. I didn't notice that until I got it I or I would have found an older model that had it. very disappointingit does not grind food spices fine enough.Only if you have VERY SMALL hands will the 2" version suit you. If you fill the the top portion of the grinder section, the posts on the bottom of the lid can no longer properly fit and seat for grinding.

And, as others have said, there is no screen on the top of the bottom "hopper" to catch larger un-ground material to keep it separate from the ground material.

I am confused as to the design and purpose of this device and will be returning it.Grinder has cheap plastic blades and not metal like it shows in the listing, and there was no Kief catcher screen included. Looks nothing like was shown in the listing. After reading other 1-star reviews, I see others had the same experience. Returned back to Amazon. I went and purchased one from the kozo-grinders.com site and got what is described.Its missing the crucial middle part. Just order from the manufacturer instead.If all ur flower is super dry this is your guy but for anything with density to it do not order this grinder spend that extra $20 avoid buying 2 like me
